strings.Clubmeisterschaft: Ligen (A, B, C …) mit: Club championship: leagues (A, B, C …) each with one or two drawn round-robin groups (best of three sets, match tiebreak), table as in the DTB template, knockout stage for the top league with semi-finals and final, play-offs between neighbouring leagues. Doubles: two neighbouring leagues form a doubles league; the partners (one person each from the upper and lower league) and the groups are drawn, with a knockout stage per doubles league. Members enter in the member app, arrange the date themselves – with court booking if “Courts” is active – and enter the result. The sports coordinator makes the draw, sets the deadlines, sends reminders and makes corrections; when the season is closed, the club champions go on the honours board and the play-offs decide the league placement for the next season. League placement can be imported once from Excel/CSV. Tables and brackets are also available on the tablet.

Club championship: leagues (A, B, C …), each with one or two drawn round-robin groups (best of three sets, match tiebreak), table as in the DTB template, knockout stage for the top league with semi-finals and final, relegation between neighbouring leagues. Doubles: two neighbouring leagues form a doubles league, the partners (one person each from the upper and lower league) and the groups are drawn, knockout stage per doubles league. Members sign up in the member app, arrange the date themselves – with court booking if “Courts” is active – and enter the result. The sports officer runs the draw, sets deadlines, sends reminders and makes corrections; at the end of the season the club champions go onto the honours board and relegation decides the next season's placement. Placement can be imported once from Excel/CSV. Tables and brackets are also available on the tablet. LK tournaments: import the tournament day from nuLiga (XML, several tournaments together, optionally the entry list as CSV), check players in on the tablet or in the admin area and record the entry fee as cash or digital (separate cash report), take over courts from nuLiga and optionally block them in the booking system, distribute courts in the tournament control centre, schedule with matches that slide back, results on the tablet, TV view for the clubhouse, player page via QR code and a results list to type up in nuLiga.

Club championship: leagues (A, B, C …) with one or two drawn groups of “everyone against everyone” (best of 3 sets, match tie-break), table as in the DTB template, knockout round of the top league with semi-finals and final, relegation between neighbouring leagues. Doubles: two neighbouring leagues form a doubles league; the partners (one person each from the upper and lower league) and the groups are drawn, knockout round per doubles league. Members sign up in the member app, arrange the date themselves – with a court booking if “Courts” is active – and enter the result. The sports officer draws, sets the deadlines, reminds and corrects; at the end of the season the club champions go onto the honours board and the relegation decides the divisions for the next season. The divisions can be imported once from Excel/CSV. Tables and brackets are also on the tablet. LK tournaments: import the tournament day from nuLiga (XML, several tournaments together, optionally the entry list as CSV), check players in at the tablet or in the admin area and record the entry fee in cash or digitally (own cash report), take over courts from nuLiga and optionally block them in the booking system, assign courts in the tournament control, schedule with matches moving up, results on the tablet, TV view for the clubhouse, player page via QR code and a result list to type into nuLiga. Tournament planner for your own tournaments (e.g. village tournament in tennis or football): groups + final round, round robin, knockout with seeding list or draw-your-partner tournament, sport templates (points, playing time, penalty shoot-out or tie-break), groups automatically even with uneven numbers, crossover final round with best third-placed teams, schedule with time and court without two matches in a row, moving up, results only by the tournament director (admin area or tablet with code), monitor to hang up without sign-in, teams via Excel/CSV, entry fee and honours board.
